At Striker Asphalt and Sealcoating, LLC, we deliver high-quality paving solutions designed to stand the test of time. Whether you’re building from the ground up or need to resurface existing pavement, our team has the experience and equipment to handle jobs of all sizes. We work with residential, commercial, and municipal clients to provide smooth, durable surfaces that not only improve appearance but also boost long-term functionality.

From driveways and parking lots to roadways and private lanes, we take pride in offering clean lines, proper drainage, and a solid foundation beneath every inch of pavement. We understand that quality paving begins with proper preparation, which is why we pay close attention to grading, compaction, and material selection to ensure lasting results.

When you hire Striker, you’re getting more than just asphalt—you’re getting a commitment to craftsmanship, safety, and customer satisfaction. Let us bring your project to life with professional paving that’s built to last.

Paving offers more than just a clean, finished look—it’s a smart investment in the value, safety, and durability of your property. At Striker Asphalt and Sealcoating, LLC, we help customers realize the full range of advantages that come with quality asphalt paving:

1. Enhanced Curb Appeal
A freshly paved surface adds immediate visual impact, making homes, businesses, and public spaces look clean, maintained, and professional.

2. Increased Property Value
Well-paved driveways, lots, or roads can increase the value of your property by improving both appearance and functionality.

3. Better Safety and Accessibility
Smooth, even surfaces reduce trip hazards and vehicle damage while improving traction and accessibility for everyone.

4. Long-Term Cost Savings
Durable asphalt paving minimizes the need for constant repairs, reducing maintenance costs over time.
